'''Casey Mongillo''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mongillo was born on October 22, 1987, in Bristol, Connecticut. They became a voice actor as an adult. They joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|JN}}, where they gained two notable roles: [[Goh's Cinderace]] and [[Professor Cerise]]'s assistant [[Chrysa]].

Mongillo is non-binary and uses they/them pronouns.
